# Loading the packages

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggridges)
library(reshape2)
library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
```

# Loading the data

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Viral expression data
EBV_genes = read_xlsx("EBV_genes.xlsx", col_names = T)
EBV_genes = column_to_rownames(EBV_genes, "Genes")
```

# Gene expression pattern

## Heatmap (Option 1)

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Converting dataframe to matrix
expr_matrix = as.matrix(EBV_genes)

# Creating simple metadata
coldata = data.frame(row.names = colnames(expr_matrix),
                      condition = rep("all", ncol(expr_matrix)))

# Creating DESeq2 object
dds = DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = round(expr_matrix),
                              colData = coldata,
                              design = ~ 1)

# Calculating size factors
dds = estimateSizeFactors(dds)

# Applying rlog (recommended function for a small number of genes)
rlog_data = rlog(dds, blind = TRUE)

# Extracting normalized matrix
expr_rlog = assay(rlog_data)

# Vector with gene names from the heatmap
genes = rownames(expr_rlog)
gene_annotation = data.frame(Gene = genes, Category = NA)

# Latent genes
latent_genes = c("LMP-1", "LMP-2A", "LMP-2B",
                 "EBNA-2", "EBNA-3A", "EBNA-3B/EBNA-3C", "EBNA-1.2")

# Lytic genes
lytic_genes = c("BZLF1", "BRLF1")

# ncRNAs
ncrna_genes = c("EBER-1", "EBER-2", "RPMS1", "A73")

# Assigning categories
gene_annotation$Category[gene_annotation$Gene %in% latent_genes] = "Latent (protein-coding)"
gene_annotation$Category[gene_annotation$Gene %in% lytic_genes] = "Lytic (protein-coding)"
gene_annotation$Category[gene_annotation$Gene %in% ncrna_genes] = "Latent (ncRNA)"
rownames(gene_annotation) = gene_annotation$Gene
gene_annotation = gene_annotation[, "Category", drop = FALSE]

# Defining colors
ann_colors = list(
  Category = c("Latent (protein-coding)" = "#A50F15", 
               "Lytic (protein-coding)" = "#0868AC", 
               "Latent (ncRNA)" = "#E6B85C"))

# Renaming samples to S1...S10
colnames(expr_rlog) = paste0("S", 1:ncol(expr_rlog))

# Plotting the heatmap
pheatmap(expr_rlog,
         scale = "none",
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = TRUE,
         show_colnames = TRUE,
         annotation_row = gene_annotation,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         annotation_names_row = FALSE,
         labels_row = parse(text = paste0("italic('", rownames(expr_rlog), "')")),
         color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(50))
```

## Heatmap (Option 2)

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Preparing annotation (Category)
gene_annotation$Category = factor(gene_annotation$Category,
                                  levels = c("Latent (protein-coding)",
                                             "Lytic (protein-coding)",
                                             "Latent (ncRNA)"))
ha_row = rowAnnotation(
  Category = gene_annotation$Category,
  col = list(Category = ann_colors$Category),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE)

# Heatmap
ht = Heatmap(expr_rlog,
             name = "Expression",
             col = colorRamp2(c(min(expr_rlog), 0, max(expr_rlog)),
                              c("navy", "white", "firebrick3")),
             cluster_rows = TRUE,
             cluster_columns = TRUE,
             show_column_names = TRUE,
             show_row_names = TRUE,
             row_names_gp = gpar(fontface = "italic", fontsize = 12),
             left_annotation = ha_row,
             heatmap_legend_param = list(
               title = "Expression",
               direction = "vertical"))

# Plotting with legends on the right
draw(ht,
     heatmap_legend_side = "right",
     annotation_legend_side = "right")
```

## Bubble plot

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Extracting normalized counts
norm_counts = counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)

# Log2 transformation for visualization
norm_counts_log = log2(norm_counts + 1)

# Renaming samples to S1...S10
colnames(norm_counts_log) = paste0("S", 1:ncol(norm_counts_log))

# Converting to long format
expr_long = melt(norm_counts_log)
colnames(expr_long) = c("Gene", "Sample", "Expression")

# Ordering genes from highest to lowest expression
gene_order = expr_long |>
  aggregate(Expression ~ Gene, data = _, median) |>
  arrange(desc(Expression))
expr_long$Gene = factor(expr_long$Gene, levels = gene_order$Gene)

# Bubble plot
plot_bubble = ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = Sample, y = Gene)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Expression, color = Expression), alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = c("#0868AC", "white", "#A50F15")) +
  scale_size(range = c(2, 10)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "", y = "", color = "Expression", size = "Expression") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, colour = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", colour = "black", size = 10))
print(plot_bubble)
```

## Boxplot and Ridgeline plot

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Palette with 13 colors (gradient between 3 colors)
cores_genes = colorRampPalette(c("#A50F15", "#E6B85C", "#0868AC"))(13)
names(cores_genes) = levels(expr_long$Gene)

# Boxplot
plot_EBV = ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = Gene, y = Expression)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Gene, color = Gene), size = 1, alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_boxplot(aes(color = Gene), geom = "errorbar", linewidth = 1, size = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cores_genes) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cores_genes) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Genes", y = "Expression log2(count + 1)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, colour = "black", size = 10, 
                                   face = "italic"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text.x = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold", size = 10))
print(plot_EBV)

# Ridgeline plot
plot_ridge = ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = Expression, y = Gene, fill = Gene)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7, scale = 1.2, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cores_genes) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Expression log2(count + 1)", y = "") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 10, colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10))
print(plot_ridge)
```
